claim: The Bad Hemingway Contest in California pays homage to an American novelist that won the Novel Prize in Literature in 1954.
evidencia:
Page: International Imitation Hemingway Competition. Sentence: Also known as "The Bad Hemingway Contest," The International Imitation Hemingway Competition is an annual writing competition begun in Century City, California.
Page: International Imitation Hemingway Competition. Sentence: Started in 1977 as a "promotional gag", and held for nearly thirty years, the contest pays mock homage to Ernest Hemingway by encouraging authors to submit a 'really good page of really bad Hemingway' in a Hemingway-esque style.
Page: Ernest Hemingway. Sentence: Ernest Miller Hemingway (July 21, 1899 – July 2, 1961) was an American novelist, short story writer, and journalist.
Page: Ernest Hemingway. Sentence: Hemingway produced most of his work between the mid-1920s and the mid-1950s, and won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1954.
